headline: Linn Mercy Reignites as Deadlands Front Shifts
war_summary: The latest returns show movement on two of the war’s principal ledgers. Lykos Isle has shifted to five Warden strategic bases against two Colonial, with four ownership events in six hours after the previous edition’s closer four-to-three balance; casualties remain heavy, though the immediate pace is cooling. Deadlands has also changed by one base, now three Warden to eight Colonial, and logged two events in the latest two hours amid the war’s heaviest losses. Linn Mercy is the liveliest fresh front: four events arrived in two hours and 29 across the day, while both casualty rates and enlistments have accelerated sharply. Fisherman’s Row remains divided at six Colonial bases to three Warden, but its 19-event day has produced no movement in the latest two hours. Stonecradle, once active with 12 daily events, is likewise quiet at nine Warden bases. Weathered Expanse records no ownership events, yet its casualty mill is still turning hard, with Warden losses accelerating; Stlican Shelf and Endless Shore show earlier movement but no recent action. The front remains broad, but the newest base-changing signs center on Linn Mercy, Deadlands, and Lykos Isle.
